  • Uses of WhoStatelessConfigurer in org.jwcarman.who.spring.security

    Subclasses with type arguments of type WhoStatelessConfigurer in org.jwcarman.who.spring.security
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    final class 
    WhoStatelessConfigurer
    Mounts who's stateless sign-in methods, every StatelessLoginMethod bean (API keys, bearer JWTs), into a chain that never reads or creates a session: the security context lives in the request only, and the request's session is hidden from the whole chain, so a session cookie that another chain made signs nothing in here, and is neither given a new id nor ended.
    Methods in org.jwcarman.who.spring.security that return WhoStatelessConfigurer
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    static WhoStatelessConfigurer
    WhoSecurity.stateless()
    Returns a configurer that mounts only who's stateless sign-in methods (API keys, bearer JWTs) into a chain with no session and no CSRF, answering a signed-out request with 401.
